questions.explanation: «Мцыри» — романтическая поэма М. Ю. Лермонтова (1839).

questions.stem: Автор комедии «Ревизор»
questions.explanation: «Ревизор» (1836) — социальная сатира на чиновничество.

questions.stem: Автор романа «Война и мир»
questions.explanation: Роман-эпопея о событиях 1805–1812 гг.

questions.stem: Автор романа «Преступление и наказание»
questions.explanation: Главный герой — Родион Раскольников.

questions.stem: Автор пьесы «Вишнёвый сад»
questions.explanation: Последняя пьеса А. П. Чехова (1903).

questions.stem: Автор романа «Тихий Дон»
questions.explanation: Роман-эпопея о казачестве в годы революции и Гражданской войны.

questions.stem: Автор романа «Мастер и Маргарита»
questions.explanation: Роман написан в 1928–1940 гг., опубликован в 1966–1967 гг.

questions.stem: Литературный род, к которому относится «Евгений Онегин»
questions.explanation: Роман в стихах сочетает эпический сюжет и лирические отступления.

questions.stem: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Present Simple, third person singular: she goes.

questions.stem: Look! The children ___ in the garden now.
questions.explanation: «Look!» and «now» signal Present Continuous.

questions.stem: I ___ my homework yet.
questions.explanation: «Yet» is used with Present Perfect in negative sentences.

questions.stem: They ___ in Almaty since 2018.
questions.explanation: «Since» + a point in time requires Present Perfect.

questions.stem: When I came home, my mother ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Past Continuous describes an action in progress when another action happened.

questions.stem: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
questions.explanation: Past Perfect shows that one past action happened before another.

questions.stem: Tomorrow at this time I ___ on the beach.
questions.explanation: Future Continuous: an action in progress at a specified time in the future.

questions.stem: She said she ___ the book the day before.
questions.explanation: Reported speech: the Present Perfect/Past Simple moves one step back to Past Perfect.

questions.stem: We ___ to the cinema last Sunday.
questions.explanation: «Last Sunday» fixes the time in the past — Past Simple.

questions.stem: How long ___ English?
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous with «how long».

questions.stem: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: «Honest» starts with a vowel sound /ɒ/ because «h» is silent.

questions.stem: ___ Sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: Unique objects (the Sun, the Moon) take the definite article.

questions.stem: I have two brothers. ___ names are Aibek and Daulet.
questions.explanation: Possessive adjective before a noun.

questions.stem: This bag is not mine. It is ___.
questions.explanation: Absolute possessive pronoun without a noun.

questions.stem: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: «Any» is used in negative sentences with uncountable nouns.

questions.stem: Choose the correct plural: one child → two ___.
questions.explanation: Irregular plural.

questions.stem: She looked at ___ in the mirror.
questions.explanation: Reflexive pronoun when subject and object are the same person.

questions.stem: I have ___ money left; I can't buy anything.
questions.explanation: «Little» (almost none) is used with uncountable nouns with a negative meaning.

questions.stem: She plays ___ piano very well.
questions.explanation: The definite article is used with musical instruments.

questions.stem: ___ Caspian Sea is the largest enclosed body of water in the world.
questions.explanation: Seas, oceans and rivers take «the».

questions.stem: The lesson begins ___ nine o'clock.
questions.explanation: «At» is used with exact clock times.

questions.stem: My birthday is ___ June.
questions.explanation: «In» with months, years, seasons.

questions.stem: We will meet ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: «On» with days of the week and dates.

questions.stem: He is interested ___ history.
questions.explanation: Fixed collocation: be interested in.

questions.stem: She is afraid ___ dogs.
questions.explanation: Fixed collocation: be afraid of.

questions.stem: I'll take an umbrella ___ it rains.
questions.explanation: «In case» expresses precaution.

questions.stem: He went to bed late ___ he was tired.
questions.explanation: «Although» shows contrast: he was tired, but he went to bed late.

questions.stem: ___ you hurry, you will miss the bus.
questions.explanation: «Unless» = «if not».

questions.stem: You ___ wear a seat belt. It is the law.
questions.explanation: «Must» expresses obligation.

questions.stem: You ___ come with me if you don't want to.
questions.explanation: «Needn't» = it isn't necessary; «mustn't» = prohibition.

questions.stem: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: First conditional: if + Present Simple, will + infinitive.

questions.stem: If I were you, I ___ that offer.
questions.explanation: Second conditional: if + Past Simple, would + infinitive.

questions.stem: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.
questions.explanation: Third conditional: if + Past Perfect, would have + past participle.

questions.stem: The window ___ by the boy yesterday.
questions.explanation: Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3.

questions.stem: English ___ all over the world.
questions.explanation: Present Simple Passive.

questions.stem: The new bridge ___ next year.
questions.explanation: Future Simple Passive.

questions.stem: You ___ see a doctor. You look pale.
questions.explanation: «Should» is used for advice.

questions.stem: I wish I ___ more free time.
questions.explanation: After «wish» about the present, use Past Simple.

topics.name: Grammar: Reported speech, relative clauses and word order

questions.stem: "I am tired," he said. → He said that he ___ tired.
questions.explanation: Backshift: am → was.

questions.stem: "Where do you live?" she asked me. → She asked me where I ___.
questions.explanation: In reported questions the word order is that of a statement, with backshift.

questions.stem: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.
questions.explanation: «Who» refers to people as the subject of a relative clause.

questions.stem: This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: «Which» (or «that») refers to things.

questions.stem: The girl ___ bag was stolen called the police.
questions.explanation: «Whose» indicates possession.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word order.
options: Do you know is where the station?
Do you know where the station is?
Do you know where is the station?
Do you know where the station does?
questions.explanation: In an embedded question the word order is that of a statement.

questions.stem: A synonym of "big" is
questions.explanation: Large means big.

questions.stem: An antonym of "ancient" is
questions.explanation: Ancient = very old; modern = of the present time.

questions.stem: He was so ___ that he couldn't answer the question.
questions.explanation: An adjective is needed after «so».

questions.stem: Choose the correct noun: She is a very successful ___. (act)
questions.explanation: Act → actor/actress is a person.

questions.stem: The phrasal verb "give up" means
questions.explanation: He gave up smoking = He stopped smoking.

questions.stem: The phrasal verb "look after" means
questions.explanation: She looks after her little brother.

questions.stem: Please ___ your shoes before you enter the house.
questions.explanation: Take off = remove clothes/shoes.

questions.stem: She is very good ___ learning foreign languages.
questions.explanation: Fixed collocation: be good at something.

questions.stem: We need to ___ a decision before Friday.
questions.explanation: Collocation: make a decision.

questions.stem: The weather was awful, so we ___ the trip.
questions.explanation: Call off = cancel.

questions.stem: — Would you like some tea? — ___
questions.explanation: A polite acceptance of an offer.

questions.stem: — Thank you very much for your help! — ___
questions.explanation: «You're welcome» is the standard reply to thanks.

questions.stem: — Could you tell me the way to the library? — ___
options: Sure. Go straight and turn left.
The library is a book place.
questions.explanation: A suitable answer to a request for directions.

questions.stem: — I'm sorry I'm late. — ___
options: That's all right. Take a seat.
Me too, I have a late.
questions.explanation: Typical response to an apology.

questions.stem: — How about going to the cinema tonight? — ___
questions.explanation: Reaction to a suggestion.

questions.stem: — What do you do? — ___
options: I'm doing my homework right now.
questions.explanation: «What do you do?» asks about someone's job.

questions.stem: — Excuse me, how much is this T-shirt? — ___
options: I like it very much for today.
It is in blue colour for me.
questions.explanation: An answer about the price.

questions.stem: — I think we should recycle more. — ___
options: I don't agree to you more.
questions.explanation: «I couldn't agree more» = I completely agree.

questions.stem: — Do you mind if I open the window? — ___
questions.explanation: «No, not at all» means that the speaker does not mind.

questions.stem: — Would you like to join us for dinner? — ___
options: I'd love to, but I have to study.
questions.explanation: A polite refusal with an explanation.
